pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 80 °C·d above 6 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1500 °C·d$(). Best near 25 °C; stops above 38 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -3 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7.5 (tolerates 5.5-8.5). Roots 1.2 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 110, P 22, K 150 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 2230 lb/ac (2.5 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Sunflower Seeds. Grows two blocks tall.
